Inside the window, nearly every invocation reports Status: timeout at Duration 3000 ms, with Max Memory Used around 95-98 MB, which fits the reduced 3 s timeout and 128 MB memory rather than the intended 60 s and 1024 MB. The other three functions match the IaC template.
